name: Skelly: Bare Bones Browser
subtitle: No ads, trackers or pop-ups
promotionalText: JavaScript is off by default, so ads, trackers and cookie banners never load. Pin your favorite news sites, read in Reader, or have any page read aloud.
description:
Skelly is a browser that strips websites down to the bone. JavaScript is off by default, so most ads, trackers, cookie banners and pop-ups never get the chance to load. What's left is the page you came to read, and it loads in a blink.

BARE BONES
• JavaScript is off on every site until you say otherwise. The Bare Bones button shows it for the site you're on, and one switch turns scripts back on for a site that needs them.
• The empty boxes that ads and script-only pictures leave behind are hidden.
• For finer control, block single script files on a site, or any script whose address contains a pattern.
• Pages without the extra weight go easy on your data and battery.

YOUR NEWS, ONE TAP AWAY
• Your favorite sites as tiles on the home screen, starting with popular ones for your region.
• Latest: the newest headlines from all your sites in one feed, as picture cards or a compact list.
• Save articles to read offline, pictures included.

READ YOUR WAY
• Reader shows just the article, in the text size, font and theme you like: Auto, Light, Sepia or Dark.
• Read aloud turns your news into a podcast. Sit back and let Skelly read any page to you.
• Dark by default, with Light or System in Settings.

PRIVACY FIRST
• Skelly collects nothing. No accounts, no analytics.
• Site icons and names come straight from the sites themselves, never from a third-party service that would learn what you read.
• Search with DuckDuckGo or Google, your choice.

What you browse, search and read in Skelly is yours alone.
